ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels to 25% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central fields on both lobes. High-contrast black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edges and tips. A central dark vertical wedge extends from the peduncle to the median notch. Specific black circular mottling is visible in the lower-mid region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression dividing the lobes with a pixel-based interior angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks reaching 15-20 pixels from the median curve; edge is notably jagged and non-linear across the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve on the leading edges sweeping outward and upward toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular, tan-colored high-contrast pixel clusters (diameters ~5-8 pixels) are detected on the lower-left and center-right lobes. Multiple dark, circular 'beauty marks' or spots are scattered on the inner right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible on the right lobe, trending in a vertical-diagonal orientation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive stalked and sessile barnacle colonization on both fluke tips, creating a highly irregular, crustose boundary extension.
other_distinctive_markers: The leftmost fluke tip exhibits a large, protruding cluster of organisms that significantly alters the natural silhouette of the fluke lobe.
